learning_outcomes.text: The students will be able to use learned algorithms to design object programs in C++ language.
They will be able to solve practical assignments and independently propose and implement application in the language.
They will be able to employ the methodology of test-driven programming.

assessment_rules: To successfully complete the course, students must obtain at least 75% of points on the homework assignment and at least 60% of points on the final exam. Final grades are: A (90%), B (86%), C (80%), D (70%), E (60%). The scale of assessment is preliminary/final: 40/60.
